proofs.name: advance_sharp_bound
proofs.bodyAudit: Metric projection spec gives p in V and the variational inequality <x-eta*g-p,u-p><=0. Rearrangement yields eta<g,p-u><=<x-p,p-u>. Expanding ||x-u||^2 and using ||p-x||=||x-p|| gives exactly both negative squares. Division is justified by 2*eta>0.

proofs.name: advance_proximal_minimizer
proofs.bodyAudit: Supplies feasibility and the global minimizing comparison from advance_sharp_bound by dropping only ||p-u||^2/(2 eta), then canceling the affine offset. No uniqueness is claimed for this objective by the signature.

proofs.name: prediction_mem
proofs.bodyAudit: Unfolded prediction is the current projected update. project_spec gives membership with no x0 feasibility or eta positivity requirement. A short adapter with a real algorithm-invariant purpose, not fake theorem credit.

proofs.name: prediction_prefix
proofs.bodyAudit: Inducts on iterate n under agreement for s<n. Instantiates n=t+1, converting s<t+1 to s<=t. Current g t is included, all future signals excluded. Relational h is never used in regret-bound assumptions.
proofs.actualReuse: structural induction on n; iterate recursion; Nat.lt_succ/Nat.le_of_lt_succ

proofs.name: regret_eq_loss_difference
proofs.bodyAudit: Per-round inner-subtraction linearity and ring cancellation identify the same generated trajectory with affine regret. Offset b t is identical on both sides and cancels.

proofs.name: regret_sharp_bound
proofs.bodyAudit: Induction on T scales by positive 2 eta. At successor it adds the current-step bound at iterate T with vector g T, cancels the old terminal potential and appends movement T. Base T=0 cancels initial/terminal distance with empty sum. Final division preserves signs.

proofs.name: regret_source_bound
proofs.bodyAudit: Uses regret_sharp_bound and nonnegative terminal quotient. Only terminal distance is discarded, negative movement sum remains intact. This corollary supplies the source-shaped public endpoint rather than a fake wrapper.
